messages:
maya: Hey team, customer ACCT-982 reported a sudden 3x usage spike on invoice #2026-09. They say it lines up with a high error/timeout rate from their mobile app yesterday. Can we check for duplicate token counts from retries?

evan: Looking. Do we have a customer trace id or sample request?

maya: They gave a trace id: trace:abc-7f4. Also attached a short pcap showing repeated POST /v1/generate calls after a 401 then refresh.

carla: Quick note: our gateway will replay buffered requests once auth refresh completes if the client resends. If idempotency-key is missing or rotated we can end up with two successful backend writes.

support-bot: @maya I created ticket SUP-3291 and linked invoice + ledger snapshot for ACCT-982.

evan: Pulling gateway logs for trace:abc-7f4...

evan: Found sequence: client sends req1 with Idempotency-Key: abc; got 401; client refreshes token, resends req2 without Idempotency-Key (SDK bug) -> gateway replayed req1 payload to backend after auth refresh -> backend accepted both -> two usage rows.

carla: Can you paste the gateway replay log lines?

evan: Sure: 
```
INGRESS PROXY replay triggered for trace:abc-7f4, original_req_id=R345, replayed_to_backend=B678, idempotency_key=missing
auth_refresh=success, client_resend=R346
```

carla: That's consistent. Also looking at billing ledger: two meter rows within 1s, tokens 1250 each. So invoice shows ~2500 tokens for one logical call.

maya: Customer says mobile SDK v1.3.2 does an auth rotation that drops custom headers during token swap. They repro locally.

carla: Immediate mitigations: 1) backfill a dedupe in ingestion that considers (customer_id, request_hash, window 10s) before emitting ledger rows; 2) patch gateway to preserve and forward Idempotency-Key during replay; 3) recommend customer upgrade SDK to 1.3.3 which we will patch to keep headers during refresh.

evan: Agreed. For reconciliation we should refund duplicated row. Ledger-bot, can you list ledger ids for ACCT-982 around 2026-09-08T17:02?

ledger-bot: Found ledger entries: L-79821 (tokens=1250, req_hash=sha1:aa11), L-79822 (tokens=1250, req_hash=sha1:aa11), created at 2026-09-08T17:02:11 and 2026-09-08T17:02:12. Both have different request_id but same payload hash.

carla: Perfect — duplicate by payload hash. Action plan: refund L-79822, mark it deduped, and update billing export. Also add a short-term filter to avoid emitting the second row to billing for identical hash within 30s.

maya: Customer asked for repro steps so they can validate SDK patch. Provide them a minimal curl repro they can run: 
```
# step 1: simulate initial request that fails auth
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer EXPIRED" -H "Idempotency-Key: abc" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
# step 2: refresh token, resend WITHOUT idempotency header (this triggers duplicate)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer NEWTOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

carla: Also include this db query for support to verify duplicates: 
```
SELECT id, customer_id, tokens, req_hash, created_at FROM ledger WHERE customer_id='ACCT-982' AND req_hash='sha1:aa11' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10;
```

evan: I'll open a PR for gateway change to copy Idempotency-Key into replay envelope and add unit test. Also adding a metrics alert for "replayed_requests_without_idempotency".

maya: Thank you. Customer wants ETA for refund + SDK patch. Carla, can you own the refund comms and confirm when done?

carla: On it. ETA for refund 48h after verifying ledger snapshot. I'll also attach an itemized invoice showing the refunded line and updated total.

maya: Final ask: can infra add an automated daily reconciliation that flags repeated req_hash within 60s and creates draft refunds for review? That would catch future cases.

carla: Filing infra ticket INFRA-614 for reconciliation job. Assigning to eng-ops.

ingress-proxy: Note: transient corner case where replay happens but auth header gets injected late; patching now to forward all original headers in replay envelope. Deploying canary to us-west-2.

maya: Great. I'll update customer: 1) we will refund the duplicate charge, 2) we are patching gateway + SDK, 3) adding short-term dedupe and longer-term reconciliation. ETA ~48h for refund, PRs and canary today. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Updated ticket SUP-3291 with plan and assignees.

maya: Closing the slack thread, will re-open if any regressions seen after canary."
